english: Take this, Dejiko!!
// SE: water gun firing sound
Ginyaa!?\nTaken down by the likes of Usada, nyo!!
And Dejiko's out!
So frustrating, nyo!!\nI didn't want to lose to Usada\nof all people, nyo!!
O-ho-ho-ho!\nMy shooting sense is better than yours too!
Anyway, Usada!\nWhy are you still here, nyo!\nGo back to Gamers, nyo!
Why?
'Why' is not the answer, nyo!\nYou've got no business here anymore, nyo!
You said it yourself, right?\nThat my reason for losing\nwas picking the wrong friends.
So what, nyo?

Which means, if I become friends
with the same people Dejiko's friends with,
the conditions are the same!!
There'd be no reason for me to lose!
Ohh, I see, nyo... NOT, nyo!!\nYou lost, Usada, nyo!
I just won! That makes us even!
You're such a sore loser, nyoo!!
Your guard's down, Usada!
// SE: water gun firing sound
Aaah!?
Usada's out!\nYou put up a great fight for your first time,\nbut too bad!
Hey!\nIt's Dejiko's fault I lost!
Serves you right, nyo~.
No looking away\nin this water-gun battle.
Exactly!!
// SE: water gun firing sound, dodged by Rena
Not a chance!
Ohh, it's down to Aria and Rena!\nThis duel's gonna be worth watching!

Sorry, but I'm taking this win!
A pro keeps track of her opponent's
remaining shots too...
You've got one shot left at most, Rena!

With that much water, your range
is two meters at most,
three if you're lucky.
This match is mine.
You're not thinking this through, Aria.
What was that?
A club veteran keeps track\nof the disqualified players'\nremaining shots too!
Usada and Dejiko's water guns!?\nWhen did you—!?
Now I've got the ammo advantage.\nCome on, let's settle this!
...I see.\nNow I understand how you've\nsurvived this far.
But with your skill,\ntaking me down is impossible!
Is that so? I wonder~
No mercy! Here I go!
// Rena moves a beat later
It'll be hard for Rena to catch\nAria's movements. Unless she can force\nit into real close quarters.
But Aria's low on ammo.\nTo land a hit before running dry,\nshe has to get close!
That's what makes it fun!\nRena! Show 'em the pride\nof a club veteran!

I've got three shots.
Rena's got an estimated eight.
But she's holding three guns—
there's always an opening when she switches!
Hiyah!
// SE: water gun firing sound, dodged by Aria
Now! Her right gun's empty—she's switching!
That's Aria!\nCircling to the right and closing in!
Got her hooked!
Wh—!?
// SE: water gun firing sounds x2; Aria and Rena are hit simultaneously.
Ugh!
Hyah!
That's enough!\nHmm, looked like a simultaneous hit to me,\nbut what do you think?
I couldn't see a difference either.
I couldn't tell at all!
Then it's a draw!\nBoth of you win!
Tch... how careless of me...
Phew... I thought I had it, though.
That was a duel for the ages, wasn't it.
You were both wonderful, you know~
Rena... at the end, how did your right water gun\nstill have two shots' worth of water?\nIt didn't look like you switched.

While I was running at a distance,
I shot the refill port of my right gun
with my left gun, where you couldn't see,
to top it up.
Huh... so that's the trick?
That's something you can only do\nwith a water gun, not a real one.
I see... I was thinking in terms of real guns,\nso that idea never occurred to me...
It might not have worked\non Mii-chan or Satoko-chan.
You got me.\nIt was a draw, but it feels like I lost.
You're amazing.\nAn amateur, yet you fought thinking through\nyour weapon's traits and your opponent's mind...
Must be the fruits of\ndaily club activities! I wonder~

(I'm starting to understand...
why a partner is needed.
Ideas and ways of thinking I don't have...
they help me grow...)
// Fade to black\n// Background: a cafeteria-like place
So what are we doing from here?
Hmm...
About that—could we head back to IS Academy?\nI'd like to get my IS serviced.
The plan to regroup at IS Academy\nwas partly for the maintenance schedule.
We also need to submit our data to IS Academy,\nand the unstable situation in Europe worries me.
Then, unless anyone objects,\nlet's go to IS Academy.\nDeparting tomorrow work for everyone?
Think we'll get ambushed?
Even without us personal-IS pilots,\nIS Academy has its teachers,\nso it can't be attacked that easily!
For us, with the enemy getting ahead of us,\nit's a somewhat reassuring destination.
// Fade to black\n// Background: in front of IS Academy
—IS Academy
// Fade to black\n// Background: IS Academy classroom
Rin and the others aren't back\nfrom reporting yet.
There's the medical checkup too,\nso it won't be quick.
I wonder if the enemy\nreally didn't set an ambush?
Right now it's the very picture of peace!
So I guess there's no idiot dumb enough\nto pick a fight with an academy\nfull of IS pilots?
There was, though...
// Koto enters.
It's an emergency, sis!
What's wrong, Hachi?
It's Koto, not Hachi!\nAnyway, it sounds like IS Academy's\ndoing something fun!
What what? What are they doing?
The fun thing is...
// Fade to black: passage of time
Hweh? A mixed tag match?
People with IS units team up\nwith people without them for matches?
Something about IS-vs-IS combat training\nnot being enough for the current situation,\nor whatever.
True—fighting in coordination\nbetween IS pilots and those who can't fly\ntakes special training.
Sounds fine.\nNothing to lose by trying.
So, what are the teams?
IS Academy's deciding based on the data,\napparently. I wonder how it'll turn out~?
// Battle map: IS Academy arena\n// Player deployment: Cecilia & Sonico, Rin & Dejiko, Charlotte & Puchiko, Laura & Siesta, and Houki & Hibiki teams are deployed.
Cecilia, let's do our best!
Leave it to me and victory is certain!
Dejiko! If we're doing this,\nwe're winning, got it!
What a pain, nyo~.\nUsada, take my place, nyo.
Just go get beaten already, Dejiko!
What'd you say, nyo!?\nDon't screw with me, nyo!!
Puchiko, I'll definitely protect you,\nso don't worry.
Fight properly, nyu.
As you wish, my princess.
Why am I not teamed with my wife?!\nUnacceptable!
Maybe because you and Hibiki together\nwould be too strong?
Let's do our best, Houki!
(So I'm the only one with a handicap...)
The rule is: if either teammate\ngoes down, you lose, right?
Looks like we'll be protecting\nour partners.
Since we can't fight selfishly,\nthis'll be different from\nan IS-vs-IS match!

Honestly, this isn't my strong suit.
Siesta, don't do anything—
just watch the surroundings
and give me directions.
That'll be easier for me.
Understood!\nI'm counting on you!
Houki, what should we do?

Don't overthink it—
just do what we always do.
We both know each other's strength,
don't we?
Yeah! All right, let's go!
The tag match is finally starting!\nAria, who do you think'll win?
I'd like to say Hibiki and Houki, but...
Dejiko's in this, y'know.\nRin's a tricky one too—\nfeels like they'll stir things up.
Then Puchiko and Charlotte,\nwho can read Dejiko's personality,\nmight have a shot?

In raw IS combat power,
Laura's a cut above the rest.
How the others fight her
is worth watching too.
What if Cecilia carried Sonico\nand fought in the air?
This format favors the Blue Tears.
When you have to protect someone\nbesides yourself, bit attacks\nare a threat, you know.
Everyone, good luuuck!!
Urgh, I wanted to compete too!!
The mixed tag match will now begin!\n3... 2... 1...
Hooold on a minute!
Who's there!?
The voice—it's coming from\ninside the arena!?
// Riko and Jeanne appear
You're doing something fun!\nRikoring wants to join too!
Riko Mine!! Jeanne!!
I'm entering the tag match\nteamed with Jeanne, so if we win,\nhand over the Blue Tears!
I will NOT!!
Intruders will be eliminated.\nThat's all.
Why nooot! Scared you'll lose!?
Still, declaring you'll join\nin this situation takes some nerve...
Maybe they have another objective...!
Don't care, nyo!!\nPreemptive strike! Eye beams!!
// Dejiko attacks Riko; battle animation off, damage to Riko
So meaan!!
The battle-start countdown\nalready ended, nyo~!\nIt's not cowardly at all, nyo~!
Riko, enough playing around?
Tch. Yeah yeah, I'll get serious.
// Grunts are also deployed in large numbers
Eeep!\nThis many participants!?
They don't look like they're\nteamed up.
Oh, I reinforced the barrier here.\nThe folks in the stands\ncan't barge in.
I locked the security shutters too.\nBeing a spectacle isn't my taste,\nbut Riko wanted it...
Then, IS fight, ready... go!!
You're not even an IS!!
// Battle begins\n// The battle itself is a normal battle.
I won't stand for this outrage!!
You're still fighting with that rust bucket?
It's grown on me as I use it.\nThat's what an IS is!
But it's just one sword, isn't it?
// Event triggers when Riko and Cecilia engage
The Blue Tears, just as I thought!
Of course!\nYou have a good eye,\nas expected of a phantom thief!
Hand it over!
Absolutely NOT!!
// Event triggers when Riko engages Dejiko
Say, haven't we met somewhere before, nyo?
Huh? Rikoring hasn't gone\nwindow-shopping at Gamers or anything?
I knew it—you're that customer\nfrom back then, nyo!!
Sorryyy, I've been busy lately\nand haven't had time for games.
I understand that, nyo...
// Event triggers when Jeanne and Siesta engage
You were useful to me.\nIf you're willing to serve me,\nI could take you on?
I'm honored by the offer, but I must decline.\nI serve the Tristain royal family—\nI cannot betray Her Majesty the Queen.
I see... the Queen, huh...
Of course, I like Louise too!
(Her...? Strange tastes...)
// Event triggers on defeating Riko
I was going for a tag match,\nso maybe I was a bit off my game~?
Excuses are unsightly.
Slipping away quietly would be way lamer!\nSee ya later!
// Event triggers on defeating Jeanne
I came at Riko's request, but forcing things\nthrough goes against my principles.
Sounds like you've got it rough\nover there too.
I don't recall asking for your sympathy.\nFarewell.
// Clear when all enemies are wiped out
That's taken care of.
Sheesh, so what happens\nto the tag match?
That's hardly the point.\nWe were attacked.
For us, it might've been\ngood training after all.
// Battle ends
Sheesh, what an ordeal, nyo...
All's well that ends well, nyu.
Still, the enemy sure is reckless!
Still after the Blue Tears, huh.\nEven though they couldn't use it anyway!
Everyone! Glad you're all safe.
It was nothing.\nEveryone's getting used to fighting.
Still, I have no idea\nwhat Riko's thinking.
What does she gain from repeating\nattacks like this, I wonder?
Not being able to read her intentions\nmakes it creepier.
Huh? Where'd Houki go?
She's not here, now that you mention it...
// Fade to black\n// Background: in front of IS Academy
That battle made me realize it again.\nAs I am, I'll only hold everyone back.
...All right, I've decided!
// Houki calls her sister on her phone\n// SE: dialing
// Fade to black\n// Background: IS Academy classroom
Aw, no going out for a while, huh.\nBoring.
It's a shame, but it can't be helped\nright now...
With security completely hijacked\nand a stunt like that,\nthe academy's gonna be in an uproar.
At times like this, let's relax.\nIf only there were something\nto take our minds off it...
Hey, anyone wanna play tennis?\nThey've gotta have tennis courts, right?
Oh, Kurumi plays tennis?
Sure do!\nGotta play once in a while\nor my skills get rusty.
Then I'll be your opponent!\nI'm pretty good, you know!
Bring it on!
Sounds great~!\nLet's all have fun!
Doubles would be fun, right?\nI'm in too!
Can you even play, nyu?
I've played before, you know!
Aoi, won't you play with me?
Huh? Me...?\nBut I'm not very athletic...
It's fine!\nI'll back you up!
True... if I play,\nmaybe others will feel like joining too.\nKurumi, I'm counting on you!
Yes!
I'll handle the court reservation\nand equipment!
Then I'll prepare lunch boxes and drinks.
I'll help too.
We'll be watching, you know~
I was good at baseball, though.\nWhat a shame.
// Fade to black\n// Background: top of stairs (or a substitute)
Sigh...\nI still feel so deflated...
With Teacher gone, who knows\nwhere [NOEL] is or what they're doing...
I don't understand anything...\nwhat should I do...
You're as passive as ever.
That voice!
...Long time no see.
How did you get in here!?
I don't think I need to say.
What do you want...?
Isn't it obvious!\nIt's about Teacher!\nWhere'd she go?
I don't know...\ndoesn't [NOEL] know?
There it is again!! Again!!\n[MERU]! What are you even doing?!
Huh?

You finally found Teacher
and got to be together!
How can you just sit there
with an 'oh, she's gone' face!?
Th-that's not fair!!\n[NOEL] met Teacher too,\nand still attacked her!!
And why am I the bad one!!
You are!!
I am not!!
Anyway, what is [NOEL]\neven doing!
Trying to prove you're better than me\nin front of Teacher!\nThat's so childish!!
What do you know, [MERU]!!
I don't know!!\nI don't know anything at aaaall!!
//END_Meru
Sigh... where'd Teacher go...
[MERU] too—everyone calls me childish,\nbut they're all the same...!
What should I do about Teacher and [MERU]...\nI don't get it at all.
You think you can just wing it, don't you?
Huh?
...Good grief.
Wait, how did you get in here!?
Figure that out yourself.
You're looking down on me as always!
So, where did Teacher go?
I don't know.\nShe was gone before I noticed...
Phew~—[NOEL] really is\nan idiot, idiot!!
Wh-what do you mean!

You're an idiot because
you don't think about anything!
You never once thought about
what Teacher's thinking
or what she's trying to do!!
But Teacher never talks\nabout that stuff...!
You call me passive,\nbut what about you!!
[MERU]'s bad too!!\nPicking a fight with me in front of Teacher!\nAnd you think you can complain!?
It's all [NOEL]'s fault!
That's crazy!\n[MERU], aren't you forcing yourself?\nWhat you're saying makes no sense!
Ptbbt!\nI'm still better than [NOEL]!!
What do you mean 'better'!\n'Better' how!!
//END_Noel
